comments.author: Material_Poem_9438
comments.body:
Ok so I came across this and got interested in the gameplay. 

So…….   
1. Maybe an auto rotation, I have to manually change from landscape to portrait   
2. The controls are a little off-putting. I want to go over there, but he goes over there. I want that coin, taps screen. Missed the coin.   
3. I know everyone wants to make money from apps but IAP are a no for me, with the control issue I feel like you’re forcing the player to buy coins. So maybe have it as a base price 

I like the concept. The visuals are very appealing. Keep up the good work.

replies.author: WeDevelopGames
replies.body:
First of all, thanks for a thoughtful response. The game works smoothly in auto rotation, but I added manual rotation to control the camera Zoom because on the landscape with auto rotation the character used to look really tiny. so with manual rotation the camera zoom is adjusted.

This is my first ever game with in app purchase and ads so I had literally no intention to make money since I have no idea how the user is going to react to it but maybe the implementation is too harsh for a game like that. 

Collecting coins is purposely made difficult otherwise it would turn out to be a really boring game. But once player plays a few times, they controls the rotation better and are able to collect more coins easily.

Thanks for the feedback. I will try to fix these issues.

replies.author: Material_Poem_9438
replies.body: Good luck with the continued development
